description: Requirements soundness review (#2017, Epic #2011 Phase 6). Answers whether design and implementation may proceed from these requirements. #2017 reuses the existing upstream requirements judgment rather than adding one: the Flow names nothing, and the requirement-side judgments (scope, terminology, acceptance criteria, edge cases, non-functional requirements) are reached through the existing selection path and the consistency-judge Agent Contract. The judgments #2017 adds over that baseline — contradiction, constraint conflict, terminology conflict, feasibility, testability — are expressed as distinct cross-artifact steps here rather than as new judgment criteria.

inputs.name: design
inputs.description: Design the requirements are checked against for constraint conflict. Optional: absence skips that cross-check.

inputs.name: plan
inputs.description: Plan the requirements are checked against for feasibility. Optional: absence skips that cross-check.

inputs.name: tests
inputs.description: Existing test evidence used for the testability judgment. Optional: absence degrades that judgment rather than skipping it, because a requirement with no way to test it is part of the answer, not a reason to stop asking.

steps.description: Existing upstream-phase selection; no Flow-local list.
Requirement against requirement: contradiction between two statements in the same set, and terminology used with two meanings across the set. Runs unconditionally on the required input.
Requirements against design: constraint conflict, where a requirement and a declared design constraint cannot both hold.
Requirements against plan: whether what is required is reachable by what is planned.
Testability: whether each requirement states an observable condition someone could check. Degrades to a requirements-only judgment when no test evidence is supplied, and records the degradation.
